name: netforge-mcp
disclaimer: NetForge MCP is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Cisco Systems, Inc.

tools.name: project_create
tools.description: Create and activate a new NetForge project backed by SQLite storage.

tools.name: project_open
tools.description: Open an existing NetForge project from SQLite and make it active.

tools.name: project_save
tools.description: Persist the active NetForge project to SQLite and optionally create a JSON backup.

tools.name: project_close
tools.description: Close the currently active NetForge project cleanly.

tools.name: project_export
tools.description: Export the active project (topology, IPAM, snapshots, metadata) to JSON or YAML.

tools.name: project_import
tools.description: Import and schema-validate a portable JSON/YAML project bundle into SQLite.

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Return active project status, stored projects, and Planned/Executed/Verified counts.

tools.name: topology_create
tools.description: Build a multi-device topology atomically from device and connection lists.

tools.name: topology_inspect
tools.description: Inspect all devices, links, coordinates, and state levels in the topology.

tools.name: topology_validate
tools.description: Validate topology graph integrity, serial clocking, link media, and switching loops.

tools.name: topology_export
tools.description: Export the active topology graph (devices, interfaces, connections) as JSON or YAML.

tools.name: topology_visualize
tools.description: Generate Mermaid diagram and ASCII adjacency summary of the active topology.

tools.name: topology_analyze
tools.description: Analyze topology with NetworkX: components, SPOFs/bridges, STP cycles, shortest path.

tools.name: device_add
tools.description: Add a network device using a verified Packet Tracer model from the DeviceCatalog.

tools.name: host_configure
tools.description: Configure DHCP or static IPv4/mask/gateway on a PC/Laptop/Server in PT & topology.

tools.name: device_remove
tools.description: Remove a device, its links, and its IPAM allocations from the active topology.

tools.name: device_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a device's interfaces, IP allocations, capabilities, and config snapshots.

tools.name: device_move
tools.description: Move a specific device to (x, y) or run auto-layout on the whole topology.

tools.name: device_list
tools.description: List devices in the active project, optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: device_capabilities
tools.description: Query verified Packet Tracer models, interfaces, capabilities, and restrictions.

tools.name: connection_create
tools.description: Connect two device interfaces with media validation and automatic cable selection.

tools.name: connection_remove
tools.description: Disconnect a link by connection_id and free both endpoint interfaces.

tools.name: connection_inspect
tools.description: Inspect one connection by ID or list all connections in the active topology.

tools.name: interface_list
tools.description: List physical interfaces of a device with occupancy, peer, and IP status.

tools.name: interface_status
tools.description: Inspect or update interface status (supports live show interfaces when live=True).

tools.name: subnet_calculate
tools.description: Calculate IPv4 or IPv6 subnet metrics (network, netmask, wildcard, usable range).

tools.name: vlsm_plan
tools.description: Design a non-overlapping VLSM plan and optionally register pools in the project.

tools.name: address_allocate
tools.description: Allocate and validate an IP address for a device interface in project IPAM.

tools.name: address_validate
tools.description: Validate all IPAM pools and allocations for conflicts, overlaps, and gateway errors.

tools.name: ipam_report
tools.description: Generate IPAM utilization summary and exportable addressing table.

tools.name: configure_interface
tools.description: Generate Cisco IOS interface, SVI, loopback, or 802.1Q subinterface config.

tools.name: configure_vlan
tools.description: Generate validated VLAN definitions and optional switch access-port assignments.

tools.name: configure_trunk
tools.description: Generate 802.1Q trunk config tailored to switch model (2960 vs. 3560/3650).

tools.name: configure_routing
tools.description: Generate static routes, RIPv2 routing, or L2 switch ip default-gateway commands.

tools.name: configure_ospf
tools.description: Generate validated OSPFv2 router configuration.

tools.name: configure_eigrp
tools.description: Generate validated EIGRP routing configuration.

tools.name: configure_dhcp
tools.description: Generate validated Cisco IOS DHCP server pool and excluded addresses.

tools.name: configure_nat
tools.description: Generate validated Cisco IOS NAT/PAT configuration.

tools.name: configure_acl
tools.description: Generate validated Standard or Extended IPv4 ACLs and optional interface binding.

tools.name: configure_ssh
tools.description: Generate SSHv2 configuration with automatic secret redaction in logs/snapshots.

tools.name: configure_stp
tools.description: Generate Spanning Tree Protocol mode and root bridge priority commands.

tools.name: configure_etherchannel
tools.description: Generate LACP/PAgP/Static EtherChannel and Port-channel configuration.

tools.name: configuration_backup
tools.description: Save a device config snapshot (reads live running-config if omitted or fetch_live).

tools.name: configuration_compare
tools.description: Compare two stored configuration snapshots using unified diff.

tools.name: command_validate
tools.description: Validate raw IOS commands against device capabilities or parse CLI error output.

tools.name: console_open
tools.description: Attach to an open Packet Tracer device CLI window and stabilize its prompt.

tools.name: console_execute
tools.description: Execute commands inside one or multiple device CLI consoles with prompt tracking.

tools.name: console_capture
tools.description: Capture current CLI buffer output for `device_name` and detect prompt/errors.

tools.name: console_inspect
tools.description: Inspect console session state, active IOS mode, hostname, and interaction profile.

tools.name: packet_tracer_detect
tools.description: Detect Cisco Packet Tracer installation, running process, DPI, window, and dialogs.

tools.name: packet_tracer_launch
tools.description: Launch Cisco Packet Tracer (or attach if already running) and wait for window.

tools.name: gui_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of Packet Tracer or a dialog offscreen and inspect layout.

tools.name: gui_calibrate
tools.description: Calibrate normalized Packet Tracer UI coordinates against live window geometry/DPI.

tools.name: gui_click
tools.description: Click an anchor, normalized `(nx, ny)`, or screen `(x, y)` inside Packet Tracer.

tools.name: gui_keypress
tools.description: Send a key chord (e.g. 'ctrl+s', 'enter') or text input to Packet Tracer.

tools.name: gui_state_inspect
tools.description: Inspect live Packet Tracer window state, open modal dialogs, calibration, and abort.

tools.name: gui_recover
tools.description: Recover from modal dialogs or arm/reset emergency automation stop.

tools.name: gui_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of calibrated GUI actions in one low-latency batch.

tools.name: gui_attach_ip_phone_power
tools.description:
Attach AC power adapter onto a 7960 IP Phone in Packet Tracer's Physical tab.

        Status: experimental: not yet validated by the 5-attempt live protocol.

tools.name: simulation_mode
tools.description: Switch Packet Tracer between 'realtime' and 'simulation' clock modes.

tools.name: simulation_start
tools.description: Activate Simulation Mode in Packet Tracer.

tools.name: simulation_stop
tools.description: Return Packet Tracer to Realtime Mode.

tools.name: packet_create
tools.description: Create and track a test PDU packet specification for Simulation Mode.

tools.name: packet_inspect
tools.description: Inspect tracked test packets and optionally parse Simulation Event List output.

tools.name: connectivity_test
tools.description: Run connectivity check via device CLI ping or offline topology path analysis.

tools.name: network_diagnose
tools.description: Run a full diagnostic audit across addressing, interfaces, VLANs, and routing.

tools.name: routing_diagnose
tools.description: Inspect routing tables, static routes, and OSPF adjacencies for routing errors.

tools.name: vlan_diagnose
tools.description: Audit VLAN assignments, trunk links, and native VLAN consistency.

tools.name: interface_diagnose
tools.description: Audit physical and logical interface status (shutdown vs up/up, duplex, IPs).

tools.name: network_repair_propose
tools.description: Generate safe, ranked self-repair proposals for all detected network findings.

tools.name: network_repair_execute
tools.description: Execute an approved self-repair proposal and sync repaired state.

tools.name: network_verify
tools.description: Run post-repair verification checks and return overall health status.

tools.name: verify_requirements_schema
tools.description: Return the declarative JSON schema and worked examples for `verify_lab`.

tools.name: verify_lab
tools.description:
Verify live Packet Tracer lab state against declarative requirements with evidence.

        ``poll_wait_seconds`` defaults to 45.0s per requirement on a live Packet Tracer bridge
        (0.0s in offline/mock runs) unless overridden explicitly.

tools.name: grade_lab
tools.description: Read native `.pka` activity score and unmet comparator leaves fail-closed.

tools.name: lab_start
tools.description: One-command live start for a `.pkt`/`.pka` file, `.md`/`.txt`/`.pdf` doc, or idea.

tools.name: lab_open
tools.description: Open a `.pkt` or `.pka` lab inside Packet Tracer via the bridge (`fileOpen`).

tools.name: lab_save
tools.description: Save the active Packet Tracer lab via bridge (`fileSave` or `fileSaveAsNoPrompt`).

tools.name: lab_status
tools.description:
Combine `verify_lab`, `grade_lab`, and task coverage, listing what is left.

        ``poll_wait_seconds`` defaults to 45.0s per requirement on a live Packet Tracer bridge
        (0.0s in offline/mock runs) unless overridden explicitly.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List live devices in Packet Tracer: canvas name, model, IOS hostname, and type.

tools.name: lab_snapshot
tools.description: Capture live lab snapshot: devices, models, IOS hostnames, links, and interfaces.

tools.name: lab_diff
tools.description: Return a readable diff of device, link, interface, and CLI config changes.
